First job: your card

Complete your secure card setup

Once your route day is confirmed, we send you a secure link to add your card. It comes by text, usually within the hour after your service day is confirmed, and by email as a backup.

  • Sent through Housecall ProHousecall Pro is the system we use for scheduling, billing and your customer portal. Use only the private link sent directly to you.

  • Never send card details by replyPurge Pros never asks you to reply with card information, and this public page never collects it.
  • Link not there yet?Check your texts and your email, spam folder included. Still missing? Text us at (317) 961-5865.

How billing works

Simple billing. Useful records. No guesswork.

You pay per visit, and your invoices and receipts are kept in your customer portal.

  • You pay per visitRecurring service is pay per visit, not a flat monthly bill.
  • Charged when we are on the wayYour card is charged when we text that we are on the way. Any extra minutes are invoiced after the visit.
  • Records in your customer portalUse the secure portal for available appointments, invoices, receipts, account details, and service records.

New recurring customers pay no start-up fee. Your first cleanup costs the same as every visit after it, even when the yard has built up.

How no start-up fee worksFirst cleanup: your regular price, up to two hours included
Starting recurring service?
Your first cleanup is billed at your regular per-visit price, with up to two hours (120 minutes) of cleanup included. Every scheduled visit after that is the same price.
What if my yard needs more than two hours?
Very few do. If yours looks like it will, we tell you before we start and agree on the extra time with you first, at $1 per minute. Nothing extra is billed without your OK.
Coming back after a break?
No start-up fee is for households new to Purge Pros. A restart cleanup is your regular visit price for the first 30 minutes, then $1 per minute. We confirm it with you before you approve anything.
One-time cleanup?
$89.99 covers the first 30 minutes, then $1 per minute.
When you pay.
Your card is charged when we text that we are on the way. Any extra minutes are invoiced after the visit. Regular scheduled visits are never charged by the minute.
Stopping.
No minimum number of visits, no cancellation fee, nothing to pay back. Full details are in the Terms & Conditions.

Once per household. We check service history before the first visit.

Before the first visit

Help us make day one effortless

A few quick details keep the first service smooth, safe, and fully documented.

  • Make the service areas accessibleUnlock any required gates and move obstacles that could prevent safe access to the selected areas, including any patio or concrete approved for scooping.
  • Share gate codes and property notesText us any code, parking direction, access detail, or property instruction that should be saved to your account.
  • Tell us about dogs outside or changing conditionsLet the office know ahead of time so current pet and access notes can be reflected on the route.
  • Keep reactive or escape-risk dogs insideReactive, protective, or escape-risk dogs must remain inside. We may pause a visit if safe service is not possible.

Text a question to (317) 961-5865

Plans change. So can we.

Need to skip, pause or reschedule?

Text the office as early as possible with gate, pet, property, or schedule changes.

Skipping or pausing

Contact us as early as possible, preferably at least 48 hours before your route day.

Asking for another day

We will try to accommodate another day, but a specific alternate day cannot be guaranteed.

Dogs away for a while

If your dogs are away and no new waste is accumulating, let us know.

A weather day is on us

Safety and weather can affect a route. If service timing or the route day must change, Purge Pros will send an update. A Purge Pros weather cancellation is not treated as a customer skip; accumulated waste is handled on the next scheduled visit without an extra accumulation charge.

After a long pause

If waste continues to accumulate during a long pause or repeated customer-requested skips, we may need a restart cleanup: your quoted visit rate includes the first 30 minutes, then $1 per actual additional minute. We confirm any restart pricing with you before you approve anything; extra time is invoiced after the visit.

Quick answers

Before your first scoop

Do I need to be home?

No. As long as the selected service areas are safely accessible and your current access notes are on the account, service can be completed without you at home.

What time will the technician arrive?

Your route day is consistent, but it is not a fixed appointment time. We send an en-route text when the technician is heading your way.

When will my card be charged?

Your card is charged when we text that we are on the way. Any extra minutes are invoiced after the visit: time past 30 minutes on a restart or one-time cleanup, or extra time you agreed to before a first cleanup that needs more than two hours. What you were charged up front counts toward the total; it is not added a second time.

Regular scheduled visits are never charged by the minute. There is no flat monthly bill.

Where do I add my card?

Through the secure link we text you, usually within the hour after your service day is confirmed. The same link is emailed too, as a backup. It comes through Housecall Pro, the system we use for scheduling, billing and your customer portal. This page does not collect payment information, and you should never send card details in a text reply.

If the link has not reached you, text us at (317) 961-5865.

Where is my customer portal?

Your portal invitation is sent separately by email. Check your spam or promotions folder if it is not in your main inbox, then save the link for future access.

What if access, weather, or my plans change?

Text the office as early as possible with gate, pet, property, or schedule changes. If weather affects the route, Purge Pros will communicate the updated plan.

Need help?

Questions before your first visit? We are a text away.

Text us and our team answers as soon as possible. Prefer to talk? Call the same number.
